# JihedAiLabs Ecosystem (Full Context)

> Detailed index of JihedAiLabs public repositories.


## [ai-skills](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/ai-skills)
- **Description**: Pragmatic AI Engineering Skills Library for LLMs, RAG, Agents, MCP & Spring AI
- **Type**: library
- **Topics**: agents, ai-engineering, guardrails, llm, mcp, prompt-engineering, rag, spring-ai, vector-database
- **Agent Entry Point**: None
- **Human Entry Point**: [README.md](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/ai-skills/blob/main/README.md)


## [bpmn-provisioning-patterns](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/bpmn-provisioning-patterns)
- **Description**: Real-world orchestration patterns with Camunda + Spring Boot + Kafka, modeled on telecom number portability: transactional outbox, idempotent consumer, sagas, compensation, and SLA timeouts.
- **Type**: library
- **Topics**: bpmn, camunda, kafka, spring-boot, telecom, saga-pattern
- **Agent Entry Point**: None
- **Human Entry Point**: [README.md](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/bpmn-provisioning-patterns/blob/main/README.md)


## [cyber-skills](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/cyber-skills)

- **Type**: library
- **Topics**: appsec, awesome, blue-team, cloud-security, cybersecurity, infosec, pentesting, red-team, security, security-skills
- **Agent Entry Point**: None
- **Human Entry Point**: [README.md](https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/cyber-skills/blob/main/README.md)
